title: Bizi Bir Arada Tutan Şey
author: Gülçağ Konçe
description: Tiny in stature, the Mahomi people live together with the other members of their tribe in a world filled with love and happiness. And what they enjoy most of all is HUGGING! Deeply connected to nature and keenly aware of their surroundings, the Mahomis one day come across a curious object carried to them by the wind. They have never seen anything like it before: two pieces of wood joined by a spring, with strange holes in the middle. What could this mysterious object be? A seat for listening to beautiful stories? A springboard? Or perhaps a puppet character? At last, one of the Mahomis cries out with a wonderfully imaginative idea: “I’ve got it!
english_title: The Thing That Holds Us Together
